title: FMC-DETR: Frequency-Decoupled Multi-Domain Coordination for Aerial-View Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2509.23056v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Remote sensing object detection is a critical technology for real-world applications such as natural resource monitoring, traffic management, and UAV-based rescue. Detecting tiny objects in high-resolution aerial imagery remains challenging due to weak visual cues and insufficient global context modeling in complex scenes. Existing methods often suffer from delayed contextual interaction and limited nonlinear reasoning, which restrict their ability to effectively refine shallow representations and ultimately lead to suboptimal performance. To address these challenges, we propose FMC-DETR, a frequency-decoupled fusion framework for aerial-view object detection. First, we propose the Wavelet Kolmogorov-Arnold Transformer (WeKat) backbone, which employs cascaded wavelet transforms to enhance global low-frequency structure perception in shallow features while preserving fine-grained details, and further leverages Kolmogorov-Arnold

translated_title: FMC-DETR：面向航拍目标检测的频域解耦多域协同方法
translated_abstract: 遥感目标检测是自然资源监测、交通管理以及基于无人机的救援等现实应用中的一项关键技术。由于视觉线索微弱以及复杂场景中全局上下文建模不足，在高分辨率航拍图像中检测微小目标仍然极具挑战性。现有方法往往存在上下文交互延迟和非线性推理能力有限的问题，这限制了其有效优化浅层表征的能力，最终导致性能欠佳。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了FMC-DETR，一种用于航拍目标检测的频域解耦融合框架。首先，我们提出了小波Kolmogorov-Arnold Transformer（WeKat）主干网络，该网络采用级联小波变换来增强浅层特征中的全局低频结构感知，同时保留细粒度细节，并进一步利用Kolmogorov-Arnold（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出FMC-DETR频域解耦融合框架，通过小波Kolmogorov-Arnold Transformer（WeKat）主干网络增强全局低频结构感知并保留细粒度细节，从而提升航拍图像中微小目标的检测性能。
en_tdlr: FMC-DETR introduces a frequency-decoupled fusion framework with a Wavelet Kolmogorov-Arnold Transformer (WeKat) backbone that enhances global low-frequency structure perception while preserving fine-grained details, improving tiny object detection in aerial imagery.
